summary: Deep research report synthesizing findings from 3 parallel research agents on where to buy cheap MacBook Pro with Apple Silicon, 32GB RAM, 512GB/1TB in India. Covers: refurbished platforms (Cashify, Sahivalue, CeX, Amazon Renewed), new-but-discounted routes (Unicorn Store clearance, Vijay Sales bank offers), AppleCare+ eligibility rules for used Macs, a cross-platform price comparison matrix, and a buyer inspection checklist. Includes counter-arguments and risk warnings.
